en: A non-conflict (*araṇa*) state that has not yet arisen is a condition, by way of object-condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), for a non-conflict state that has not yet arisen. [In the category of] objects there are four; in predominance (*adhipati*) there are three; in decisive support (*upanissaya*) there are four.
A non-conflict state that is about to arise is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-conflict state that is not about to arise.
A non-conflict state that is about to arise is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-conflict state that is not about to arise. [In the category of] objects...
Two by way of predominance, one by way of presence, and two by way of decisive support.
